description: Source code for a TypeScript compiler utility class that sets up a virtual TypeScript environment, manages compilation options, and compiles TypeScript code to JavaScript, utilizing virtual file systems and external type definitions.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: A class that manages a virtual TypeScript environment, including setup and compilation of TypeScript code.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the virtual TypeScript environment with specified compiler options and type definitions.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles provided TypeScript code into JavaScript, returning the output and diagnostics.
